query.rawSql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    ba.name AS branch_area_name
FROM `bateriku-customer-72fa8.bateriku_public.branches` b
LEFT JOIN `bateriku-customer-72fa8.bateriku_public.branch_areas` ba
    ON b.branch_area_id = ba.id
WHERE
    ba.name IS NOT NULL
    AND UPPER(ba.name) NOT LIKE '%TEST%'
ORDER BY branch_area_name;

WITH johor_hq_branches AS (
    SELECT branch_name
    FROM UNNEST([
        'MB JB - VBK1136 (AXIA)',
        'MB JB - WUX8465 (HILUX)',
        'MB JB - WWX3343 (HILUX)',
        'MS JB  - WWT6579 (DMAX)',
        'MS JB - WWT6579 (DMAX)',
        'MS JB AFIQ RODZI',
        'MS JB AMIM',
        'MS JB AMIRUL ASYRAF',
        'MS JB BH AMIRUL ASYRAF',
        'MS JB BH RADIN',
        'MS JB BH ZULKAPLY',
        'MS JB KHIR SAWAL',
        'MS JB MAHADI',
        'MS JB MAHATHIR',
        'MS JB MAHDIR KASSIM',
        'MS JB MOHAMMAD HASBARIZAL',
        'MS JB MOHD NAZIM',
        'MS JB MUHAMAD ASYRAF',
        'MS JB ROSIDI',
        'MS JB SHAHEMAN',
        'MS JB SHAHMIERUL ARIFFIN',
        'MS JB SHAMSURI',
        'MS JB SUHAIMY EZWAN SHAH',
        'MS JB SUTHAKAREN',
        'MS JB ZAIROL AZMI',
        'HQ JOHOR BAHRU'
    ]) AS branch_name
),

first_created_at_per_branch AS (
    SELECT
        branch_id,
        MIN(created_at) AS first_created_at
    FROM `bateriku-customer-72fa8.bateriku_public.branch_time_logs`
    GROUP BY
        branch_id
),

sales_data AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN jhb.branch_name IS NOT NULL THEN 'HQ PASIR GUDANG'
            ELSE b.name
        END AS Name,

        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS Total_Sales,
        DATE(MAX(f.first_created_at)) AS Branch_Created_Date,
        MAX(b.status) AS Status,

        COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(TIMESTAMP_ADD(o.created_at, INTERVAL 8 HOUR))) AS Count_of_Days,

        COUNT(
            DISTINCT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TIMESTAMP_ADD(o.created_at, INTERVAL 8 HOUR)) * 100
            + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TIMESTAMP_ADD(o.created_at, INTERVAL 8 HOUR))
        ) AS Count_of_Months,

        COUNT(
            DISTINCT CASE
                WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TIMESTAMP_ADD(o.created_at, INTERVAL 8 HOUR)) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE('Asia/Kuala_Lumpur'))
                 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TIMESTAMP_ADD(o.created_at, INTERVAL 8 HOUR)) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE('Asia/Kuala_Lumpur'))
                THEN o.id
            END
        ) AS MTD_Sales,

        COUNT(
            DISTINCT CASE
                WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TIMESTAMP_ADD(o.created_at, INTERVAL 8 HOUR)) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE('Asia/Kuala_Lumpur'))
                THEN o.id
            END
        ) AS YTD_Sales

    FROM `bateriku-customer-72fa8.bateriku_public.orders` AS o
    LEFT JOIN `bateriku-customer-72fa8.bateriku_public.order_items` AS oi
    ON o.id = oi.order_id
    LEFT JOIN `bateriku-customer-72fa8.bateriku_public.products` AS p
    ON oi.product_id = p.id
    LEFT JOIN `bateriku-customer-72fa8.bateriku_public.branches` AS b
    ON o.branch_id = b.id
    LEFT JOIN `bateriku-customer-72fa8.bateriku_public.branch_areas` AS ba
    ON b.branch_area_id = ba.id
    LEFT JOIN first_created_at_per_branch AS f
    ON b.id = f.branch_id
    LEFT JOIN `bateriku-customer-72fa8.bateriku_public.promo_codes` AS pc
    ON pc.id = o.promo_code_id
    LEFT JOIN johor_hq_branches AS jhb
    ON b.name = jhb.branch_name

    WHERE
        TIMESTAMP_ADD(o.created_at, INTERVAL 8 HOUR) >= TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__from})
        AND TIMESTAMP_ADD(o.created_at, INTERVAL 8 HOUR) < TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__to})
        AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'refunded', 'rejected')
        AND p.consumable = TRUE
        AND (pc.code IS NULL OR pc.code != 'WARRANTY(NEWBATTERY)')
        AND (
            b.name LIKE 'HQ%'
            OR jhb.branch_name IS NOT NULL
            OR b.name LIKE '%Warehouse%'
            OR UPPER(b.name) LIKE '%WAREHOUSE%'
            OR UPPER(b.name) LIKE 'WH%'
        )
        AND b.name NOT IN ('HQ SELAYANG', 'HQ TANJUNG API')
        AND UPPER(b.name) NOT LIKE '%TEST%'
        AND ba.name IN (${branch_area})

    GROUP BY
        Name
)

SELECT
    Name,
    Total_Sales,
    Branch_Created_Date AS branch_created_date,
    Status AS branch_status,
    Count_of_Days,
    Count_of_Months,
    MTD_Sales,
    YTD_Sales,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(YTD_Sales, Count_of_Months) AS YTD_Average
FROM sales_data
ORDER BY
    Total_Sales DESC;

targets.rawSql:
WITH first_created_at_per_branch AS (
    SELECT
        branch_id,
        MIN(created_at) AS first_created_at
    FROM `bateriku-customer-72fa8.bateriku_public.branch_time_logs`
    GROUP BY
        branch_id
),

segamat_branch_aliases AS (
    SELECT branch_key
    FROM UNNEST([
        'BPM SEGAMAT',
        'BPM MUADZAM',
        'BPM SEGAMAT MUADZAM',
        'BP MUADZAM',
        'BP SEGAMAT MUADZAM',
        'BP TAMAN YAYASAN SEGAMAT'
    ]) AS branch_key
),

branch_details AS (
    SELECT
        b.id AS branch_id,
        b.name AS original_branch_name,

        TRIM(
            REGEXP_REPLACE(
                UPPER(COALESCE(b.name, '')),
                r'[^A-Z0-9]+',
                ' '
            )
        ) AS branch_key,

        ba.name AS state_hub,

        CASE
            WHEN TRIM(
                REGEXP_REPLACE(
                    UPPER(COALESCE(b.name, '')),
                    r'[^A-Z0-9]+',
                    ' '
                )
            ) = 'BP NIBONG TEBAL'
            THEN DATE '2026-08-13'
            ELSE DATE(f.first_created_at)
        END AS branch_created_date,

        b.status AS branch_status

    FROM `bateriku-customer-72fa8.bateriku_public.branches` AS b

    LEFT JOIN `bateriku-customer-72fa8.bateriku_public.branch_areas` AS ba
        ON b.branch_area_id = ba.id

    LEFT JOIN first_created_at_per_branch AS f
        ON b.id = f.branch_id
),

target_branch_metadata AS (
    SELECT
        branch_id,
        state_hub,
        branch_created_date,
        branch_status

    FROM branch_details

    WHERE
        branch_key = 'BP TAMAN YAYASAN SEGAMAT'

    QUALIFY
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY branch_id DESC
        ) = 1
),

mapped_orders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        CASE
            WHEN sba.branch_key IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'BP TAMAN YAYASAN, SEGAMAT'
            ELSE TRIM(b.original_branch_name)
        END AS Name,

        CASE
            WHEN sba.branch_key IS NOT NULL
            THEN COALESCE(tbm.state_hub, b.state_hub)
            ELSE b.state_hub
        END AS state_hub,

        o.id AS order_id,

        TIMESTAMP_ADD(
            o.created_at,
            INTERVAL 8 HOUR
        ) AS order_created_at,

        CASE
            WHEN sba.branch_key IS NOT NULL
            THEN COALESCE(
                tbm.branch_created_date,
                b.branch_created_date
            )
            ELSE b.branch_created_date
        END AS branch_created_date,

        CASE
            WHEN sba.branch_key IS NOT NULL
            THEN COALESCE(
                tbm.branch_status,
                b.branch_status
            )
            ELSE b.branch_status
        END AS branch_status

    FROM `bateriku-customer-72fa8.bateriku_public.orders` AS o

    LEFT JOIN `bateriku-customer-72fa8.bateriku_public.order_items` AS oi
        ON o.id = oi.order_id

    LEFT JOIN `bateriku-customer-72fa8.bateriku_public.products` AS p
        ON oi.product_id = p.id

    LEFT JOIN branch_details AS b
        ON o.branch_id = b.branch_id

    LEFT JOIN `bateriku-customer-72fa8.bateriku_public.promo_codes` AS pc
        ON pc.id = o.promo_code_id

    LEFT JOIN segamat_branch_aliases AS sba
        ON b.branch_key = sba.branch_key

    LEFT JOIN target_branch_metadata AS tbm
        ON TRUE

    WHERE
        TIMESTAMP_ADD(o.created_at, INTERVAL 8 HOUR)
            >= TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__from})

        AND TIMESTAMP_ADD(o.created_at, INTERVAL 8 HOUR)
            < TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__to})

        AND o.status NOT IN (
            'cancelled',
            'refunded',
            'rejected'
        )

        AND (
            REGEXP_CONTAINS(b.branch_key, r'^BP(\s|$)')
            OR sba.branch_key IS NOT NULL
        )

        AND p.consumable = TRUE

        AND b.branch_key NOT LIKE '%TEST%'
        AND b.branch_key NOT LIKE '%BGARAGE%'
        AND b.branch_key NOT LIKE '%BANNED%'

        AND (
            pc.code IS NULL
            OR pc.code != 'WARRANTY(NEWBATTERY)'
        )
),

base_orders AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM mapped_orders
    WHERE
        state_hub IN (${branch_area})
),

sales_data AS (
    SELECT
        Name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS Total_Sales,
        MIN(branch_created_date) AS branch_created_date,
        MAX(branch_status) AS branch_status,

        COUNT(
            DISTINCT DATE(order_created_at)
        ) AS Count_of_Days,

        COUNT(
            DISTINCT (
                EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_created_at) * 100
                + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_created_at)
            )
        ) AS Count_of_Months,

        COUNT(
            DISTINCT CASE
                WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_created_at)
                    = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE('Asia/Kuala_Lumpur'))
                AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_created_at)
                    = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE('Asia/Kuala_Lumpur'))
                THEN order_id
            END
        ) AS MTD_Sales,

        COUNT(
            DISTINCT CASE
                WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_created_at)
                    = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE('Asia/Kuala_Lumpur'))
                THEN order_id
            END
        ) AS YTD_Sales

    FROM base_orders

    GROUP BY
        Name
)

SELECT
    Name,
    Total_Sales,
    FORMAT_DATE('%d-%m-%Y', branch_created_date) AS branch_created_date,
    branch_status,
    Count_of_Days,
    Count_of_Months,
    MTD_Sales,
    YTD_Sales,

    SAFE_DIVIDE(
        YTD_Sales,
        Count_of_Months
    ) AS YTD_Average

FROM sales_data

ORDER BY
    Total_Sales DESC;

SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC(created_at, DAY) AS date_col,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS Total_count
FROM `clone-330106.View.orderdetail`
WHERE $__timeFilter(CAST(created_at AS STRING))
      AND status IN ($Order_Status)
      -- AND cancelled_note IN ($Cancelled_Note)
      AND state IN ($State)
      AND Stock_pickup_at IN ($Stock_Pickup_At)
      AND name IN ($Branches)
      AND Order_category IN ($Order_Category)
      AND branch_area IN ($Branch_Area)
      AND brand IN ($Battery_Brands)
      AND UPPER(name) NOT LIKE '%TEST%'
    --   AND promo_code_name IN ($promo_code)
      -- AND branch_type IN ($branch_type)
      --       AND (
      --   branch_type IS NULL
      --   OR branch_type IN ($branch_type)
      -- )

      AND COALESCE(branch_type, 'unlabeled') IN ($branch_type)
      AND partners_name IN ($partner)
    --   AND source_category IN ($Sales_Source)
      AND promo_code_name != 'WARRANTY(NEWBATTERY)'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

WITH DailyCounts AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC(created_at, DAY) AS date_col, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS Total_count
  FROM `clone-330106.View.orderdetail` 
  WHERE $__timeFilter(CAST(created_at AS STRING))
    AND status IN ($Order_Status)
    -- AND cancelled_note IN ($Cancelled_Note)
    AND state IN ($State)
    AND Stock_pickup_at IN ($Stock_Pickup_At)
    AND name IN ($Branches)
    AND Order_category IN ($Order_Category)
    AND branch_area IN ($Branch_Area)
    AND brand IN ($Battery_Brands)
    AND UPPER(name) NOT LIKE "%TEST%"
    -- AND promo_code_name IN ($promo_code)
    AND promo_code_name != 'WARRANTY(NEWBATTERY)'
    -- AND branch_type IN ($branch_type)
      --     AND (
      --   branch_type IS NULL
      --   OR branch_type IN ($branch_type)
      -- )
    
    AND COALESCE(branch_type, 'unlabeled') IN ($branch_type)
    AND partners_name IN ($partner)
    -- AND source_category IN ($Sales_Source)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  date_col,
  CAST(
    ROUND(
      AVG(Total_count) 
      OVER (ORDER BY date_col ASC ROWS BETWEEN 1000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
    ) AS INT
  ) AS Daily_average
FROM DailyCounts
ORDER BY 1;
